subject: vt-dy
title: VT.DY.------WO.EXT.PRI.
description: Diagram in AF(D)-7 (Affinity Dynamics, Level One), on the page where Braxton argues that transfer shifts can be viewed with respect to the 'natural' (or unnatural) dynamics manifested on the planet — registered in three things: (1) different types of beings in society, (2) physical universe areas on the planet coloring the affinity nature underlying how information is perceived, (3) the progressional spread of information manifesting in mystical terms. (C)VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) is crossed with WO-EXT-PRI: the question is what vibrational dynamics produces when crossed with WO-EXT-PRI. The partner WO-EXT-PRI is the structural endpoint. COS-P (cosmic particulars) branches from the main line and carries two lines: SPT-GH (spiritual growth), which carries ACT (activism), and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), which leads to T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From T-C-IMP the chain runs down through TR-INFO (trans-information) and POL-DY (political dynamics) to MOT-DY.
